description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various video categories, divided into a total of 14 distinct slices. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of the pie, while the corresponding percentage values are displayed directly inside each slice. Moving clockwise from the top right, the categories and their proportions are as follows: "People Blogs" in orange at 17.2%, "Music" in light purple at 2.3%, "Autos Vehicles" in red at 4.8%, "Pets Animals" in green at 3.9%, "News Politics" in orange at 4.3%, "Science Technology" in blue at 6.4%, "Comedy" in light blue at 5.6%, "Travel Events" in yellow-green at 4.6%, "Gaming" in grey at 6.4%, "Sports" in pink at 7.7%, "Film Animation" in brown at 4.6%, "Entertainment" in purple at 13.9%, "Education" in red at 8.7%, and "Howto Style" in green at 9.7%. The segments do not appear to be ordered by size, and there are no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices within the chart.
